title: Prove finite separation and fund dyadic detection of orthogonal witnesses
body:
Prove a finite separation bound and implement a funded dyadic detector for a selected rational orthogonal inverse-circuit endpoint. If d is the path dimension, q counts named calls, A/B is the reduced Cayley parameter, and C is the product of all scalar denominators, every nonzero endpoint has magnitude at least `eta = 1/[C(3B)^(dq)]`. The detector pays all scalar amplification, matrix-entry quantization and data truncation, obtains error at most eta/4, and decides zero/nonzero at threshold eta/2. It does not use the exact endpoint as its decision oracle.

The [written proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26fe40cbca6972a0e392e9248a9cb8a84368530b/research/orthogonal-witness-precision/PROOF.md), [detector](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26fe40cbca6972a0e392e9248a9cb8a84368530b/research/orthogonal-witness-precision/detector.py), and [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26fe40cbca6972a0e392e9248a9cb8a84368530b/research/orthogonal-witness-precision/RESULT.json) define the result. This answers the numerical-detectability limitation of the exact orthogonal witness. The complete rational register grammar retains every role, true named inverses and old values on aliased queries. A zero at one chosen tuple is not a universal equality certificate.

The sufficient precision and detector bit sizes are polynomial in the explicit program, word, scalar and parameter sizes after the path word is supplied. This is not a new bit-complexity theorem for the upstream coefficient producer. Matrix construction and qd² dense replay products remain paid. No optimal guard, IEEE backend guarantee, native Clifford relation, physical tape tariff, supplier admission or complete kappa improvement is claimed. The selected frontier remains unchanged at conditional kappa 60403/20000000.

Base: `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. Ali Romman's [PR #5315](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5315), consumed at `9bebc267c4608e51fcc94a543b8e0d66077cdfbb`, supplies the orthogonal construction, literal action and retained test oracles. @krzysztofwojt supplied the inverse compiler and shortest-word theorem in [PR #5262](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5262); retained notices credit @zxv for [PR #5235](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5235) and the dirty-echo/tensor/phase and rational-series lineage. [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26fe40cbca6972a0e392e9248a9cb8a84368530b/research/orthogonal-witness-precision/SOURCES.json) retain exact predecessor bytes in this branch's ancestry. Cayley transforms, Hadamard's determinant inequality and forward-error propagation are classical. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/orthogonal-witness-precision
```

Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized modes pass with `PASS_ORTHOGONAL_WITNESS_PRECISION`. All 102 cases pass: 24 zero and 78 nonzero, with every returned coordinate checked against its error bound. The tests include 101 separate dense exact comparisons, seven rejection controls, cancelling grid points, tiny parameter/discrepancy 2^-80, scalar gains 2^100, dirty returns and aliases. The stress case has 65,536 lowest-degree words, dimension 17 and a sufficient 2,262-bit fractional grid. Four actual code mutations fail in both modes before receipt comparison.

Committed bytes, every declared source pin's direct ancestry, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free replays pass; all 23 exported files remain unchanged. No independent human/proof-kernel review, selected cold replay, native tape, Lean, Docker or complete kappa calculation was run. The full-history wrapper remains unpassed in this shallow checkout. An optimized sparse or native-compatible detector needs a separate caller contract and complete error/cost comparison.

Hosted [run 39996997226](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39996997226) passed planning and the registered Linux replay for published head `26fe40cbca6972a0e392e9248a9cb8a84368530b`. Hosted execution is separate from independent scientific review.
